description: Known-answer x402 payment fixture for auditor and client self-tests. A paid call settles exactly at $0.001 USDC and returns the published known answer plus a signed receipt (payer, amount, tx, server time). Useful to prove a wallet and x402 client work end to end. Failed payments are not charged and return a machine-readable error. Spec: GET /v0/fixture/spec. PAID: $0.001 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/fixture/settle.
name: fixture_settle
title: Known-answer x402 payment fixture (signed receipt)
